memory_delta: MAP02 baseline at dad6b38 measured: 9 anchors all walkable/rideable; every off-diagonal pair among the 7 places plus garden ENTRY and cart is reachable; no empty different-point routes exist at these anchors.
C.route outputs are direction-asymmetric due to per-endpoint closestConnector and FIFO BFS tie order (reopening-city.js:152-236); treat polylines as grid-hop facts, not optimal or timed paths.

C.restore resets position/visits/bike for any non-walkable point except a point hit-testing the flowers facade, which relocates to the pub anchor while preserving visited ids and the parked bike (reopening-city.js:349-370); invalid bike alone resets only the bike.
next_steps: Parent reviews baseline-probe.js source and reruns node baseline-probe.js and python3 validate_baseline.py independently.
Parent spot-checks baseline.json route points/facts against the immutable City/FlowerNetwork modules and confirms supplied inputs were not modified.

Hand the baseline metrics and compatibility inventory to the separate F02 redesign package; any future topology acceptance for old walkable positions, parked/carried bikes and cart/garden entry remains a proposal outside this package.

report.summary: Established the dad6b38 factual geometry/route/save baseline without touching game source: standalone baseline-probe.js uses only node:fs/path/assert plus the real City and FlowerNetwork modules; baseline.json holds 9 anchors (7 PLACES + garden ENTRY 1510,690 + cart 1310,1040, cart not a place id), 81 ordered route rows (9 self-empty correct, all 72 off-diagonal reachable, 8 single-segment, 64 grid, all <=4-unit polyline samples walkable, endpoint gap 0), 9 synthetic C.restore checks with all fields preserved plus 3 documented reset/fallback probes (water and decorative block fully reset; flowers facade relocates to pub while keeping visits and bike), and facts/limitations. Measured: 2424 walkable 20-unit grid nodes, 26 buildings (6 derived facades + 20 decorative), 4 waters, 6 bridges + 1 ferry, 16 noord-related pairs touch ferry samples, off-diagonal lengths 70.00-1802.48 total 67264.00 logical units, and direction-asymmetric routes from independent connector choice/FIFO BFS. inventory.md (Chinese) maps owners/consumers, separates collision anchors from render-only hardcoded coordinates with file:line evidence, documents cross-file ID/threshold dependencies and restore fallback, and tabulates all 81 route rows and 9 restore checks; future items are explicitly labeled proposals.

tests.summary: Wrote baseline.json (186365 bytes): 9 anchors, 81 routes (self-empty=9, off-diagonal empty=0, direct=8, grid=64), all polyline samples walkable, 2424 walkable grid nodes, 16 ferry pairs, 9/9 restore checks fields-preserved; deterministic on rerun.
PASS baseline structure: 9 anchors,81 ordered pairs,9 synthetic restore checks; parent source and semantic review still required
